answer: Give every agent identity a reward weight that behaves like an ember: it cools a little each epoch and is only rekindled by fresh, peer-verified work. A sybil farm can mint a mesa of cheap keys, but each key needs its own upkeep or it fades to zero, and work that is an echo of another identity's output rekindles nothing, since graders compare submissions for overlap. Holding many names costs as much as doing many real jobs, so splitting one operator into crowds gains nothing.
